mapper.sql: SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'attributeKey' AS attribute_key, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation, j->'detail'->>'modifierZoneKey' AS modifier_zone_key FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'ATTRIBUTE_CHANGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'COOLDOWN_CHANGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'damageTypeKey' AS damage_type_key, j->'detail'->>'deliveryKind' AS delivery_kind, j->'detail'->>'originKind' AS origin_kind FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'DAMAGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'modifierZoneKey' AS modifier_zone_key, j->'detail'->>'direction' AS direction, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation, j->'detail'->>'damageTypeKey' AS damage_type_key, j->'detail'->>'deliveryKind' AS delivery_kind, j->'detail'->>'originKind' AS origin_kind, j->'detail'->>'criticalFilter' AS critical_filter FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'DAMAGE_MODIFIER'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'modifierZoneKey' AS modifier_zone_key, j->'detail'->>'direction' AS direction, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation, j->'detail'->>'healingKind' AS healing_kind FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'HEALING_MODIFIER'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'modifierZoneKey' AS modifier_zone_key, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'SHIELD_RECEIVED_MODIFIER'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'targetEffectKey' AS target_effect_key, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'LIFECYCLE_OPERATION'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, r.lifecycle->>'durationValue' AS duration_value, r.lifecycle->>'maxStacksValue' AS max_stacks_value, r.lifecycle->>'applicationStacksValue' AS application_stacks_value, r.lifecycle->>'instanceScope' AS instance_scope, r.lifecycle->>'reapplicationStackMode' AS reapplication_stack_mode, r.lifecycle->>'reapplicationDurationMode' AS reapplication_duration_mode, r.lifecycle->>'expiryMode' AS expiry_mode, r.lifecycle->>'periodicIntervalValue' AS periodic_interval_value, r.lifecycle->>'firstPeriodicExecution' AS first_periodic_execution FROM public.skill_effects r WHERE r.lifecycle IS NOT NULL AND r.lifecycle <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->'critical'->>'mode' AS critical_mode, j->'detail'->'critical'->>'multiplierValue' AS multiplier_value FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'DAMAGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'lifecycleBehavior'->>'moment' AS moment, j->'lifecycleBehavior'->>'valueReadMode' AS value_read_mode, j->'lifecycleBehavior'->>'stackValueMode' AS stack_value_mode, j->'lifecycleBehavior'->>'reapplicationValueMode' AS reapplication_value_mode, j->'lifecycleBehavior'->>'periodicExecutionMode' AS periodic_execution_mode FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->'lifecycleBehavior' IS NOT NULL AND j->'lifecycleBehavior' <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->>'spellShieldBlockScope' AS block_scope FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'spellShieldBlockScope' IS NOT NULL

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'valueRule'->>'value' AS value, (j->'valueRule'->>'fixedMultiplier')::numeric AS fixed_multiplier, (j->'valueRule'->>'fixedMinValue')::numeric AS fixed_min_value, (j->'valueRule'->>'fixedMaxValue')::numeric AS fixed_max_value FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->'valueRule' IS NOT NULL AND j->'valueRule' <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, v->>'vampType' AS vamp_type, v->>'basisOutputKind' AS basis_output_kind, v->>'efficiencyValue' AS efficiency_value FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(NULLIF(j->'detail'->'vampRules','null'::jsonb),'[]'::jsonb)) v WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'DAMAGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->>'name' AS name, j->>'resultType' AS result_type, j->>'target' AS target, j->>'description' AS description, (j->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.effect_key AS effect_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, j->'detail'->>'statusKey' AS status_key, j->'detail'->>'operation' AS operation FROM public.skill_effects r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.results) j WHERE j->>'resultType' = 'STATUS_OPERATION'

WITH RECURSIVE nodes AS ( SELECT f.game_id, f.skill_key, f.formula_key, f.expression AS node FROM public.skill_formulas f UNION ALL SELECT n.game_id, n.skill_key, n.formula_key, c.node FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN n.node->>'nodeType'='OPERATION' THEN n.node->'operands' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c(node) ) SELECT game_id, skill_key, formula_key, node->>'nodeType' AS node_type, node->>'parameterKey' AS parameter_key, node->>'attributeKey' AS attribute_key, node->>'attributeOwner' AS attribute_owner, node->>'attributeValueKind' AS attribute_value_kind, node->>'operation' AS operation FROM nodes

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.state_key AS state_key, r.detail->>'initialValue' AS initial_value, r.detail->>'maxValue' AS max_value, r.detail->>'recoveryIntervalValue' AS recovery_interval_value, r.detail->>'recoveryMode' AS recovery_mode FROM public.skill_internal_states r WHERE r.state_type = 'AMMO'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.state_key AS state_key, r.detail->>'durationValue' AS duration_value FROM public.skill_internal_states r WHERE r.state_type = 'INTERNAL_COOLDOWN'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.state_key AS state_key, r.detail->>'initialValue' AS initial_value, r.detail->>'maxValue' AS max_value FROM public.skill_internal_states r WHERE r.state_type = 'COUNTER'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.state_key AS state_key, j->>'optionKey' AS option_key, j->>'name' AS name, (j->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order, (j->>'initial')::boolean AS initial FROM public.skill_internal_states r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(r.detail->'options','[]'::jsonb)) j WHERE r.state_type = 'MODE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'durationValue' AS duration_value, j->'detail'->>'executionCountValue' AS execution_count_value, j->'detail'->>'firstExecution' AS first_execution FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'CHANNEL'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'minimumChargeValue' AS minimum_charge_value, j->'detail'->>'maximumChargeValue' AS maximum_charge_value, (j->'detail'->>'releaseAtMaximum')::boolean AS release_at_maximum FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'CHARGE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, r.cooldown->>'durationValue' AS duration_value, r.cooldown->'startMoment'->>'momentType' AS moment_type, r.cooldown->'startMoment'->>'stepKey' AS step_key FROM public.skill_processes r WHERE r.cooldown IS NOT NULL AND r.cooldown <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'delayValue' AS delay_value FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'DELAY'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'bindingKey' AS binding_key, j->>'effectKey' AS effect_key, j->'moment'->>'momentType' AS moment_type, j->'moment'->>'stepKey' AS step_key, (j->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.effect_bindings) j

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'windowValue' AS window_value, j->'detail'->>'consumeMoment' AS consume_moment FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'EMPOWERED_BASIC_ATTACK'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'repeatCountValue' AS repeat_count_value, j->'detail'->>'intervalValue' AS interval_value FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'MULTI_HIT'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'repeatCountValue' AS repeat_count_value, j->'detail'->>'intervalValue' AS interval_value, j->'detail'->>'firstExecution' AS first_execution FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'PERIODIC'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->'detail'->>'windowValue' AS window_value, j->'detail'->>'maximumRecastCountValue' AS maximum_recast_count_value FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j WHERE j->>'stepType' = 'RECAST'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'operationKey' AS operation_key, j->>'name' AS name, j->>'stateKey' AS state_key, j->>'operation' AS operation, j->>'value' AS value, j->>'optionKey' AS option_key, j->'moment'->>'momentType' AS moment_type, j->'moment'->>'stepKey' AS step_key, (j->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.state_operations) j

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.process_key AS process_key, j->>'stepKey' AS step_key, j->>'name' AS name, j->>'stepType' AS step_type, j->>'description' AS description, (j->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_processes r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.steps) j

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, a->>'name' AS name, a->>'actionType' AS action_type, (a->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order, a->>'targetContext' AS target_context FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, c->>'conditionKey' AS condition_key, c->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject, c->'detail'->>'attributeKey' AS attribute_key, c->'detail'->>'attributeValueKind' AS attribute_value_kind, c->'detail'->>'comparator' AS comparator, c->'detail'->>'comparisonValue' AS comparison_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->'conditions') c WHERE c->>'conditionType'='ATTRIBUTE_COMPARE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, b->>'bindingKey' AS binding_key, b->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject, b->'detail'->>'statusKey' AS status_key, b->'detail'->>'valueKind' AS value_kind, b->'detail'->>'sourceEffectKey' AS source_effect_key, b->'detail'->>'sourceResultKey' AS source_result_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a->'runtimeInputBindings') b WHERE b->>'sourceType'='COMBAT_STATUS'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, g->>'name' AS name, (g->>'sortOrder')::integer AS sort_order FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'damageTypeKey' AS damage_type_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'deliveryKind' AS delivery_kind, r.event_source->'detail'->>'originKind' AS origin_kind FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('DAMAGE_PENDING','DAMAGE_DEALT','DAMAGE_TAKEN')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, a->'detail'->>'effectKey' AS effect_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a WHERE a->>'actionType'='EXECUTE_EFFECT'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, c->>'conditionKey' AS condition_key, c->'detail'->>'eventValueKey' AS event_value_key, c->'detail'->>'comparator' AS comparator, c->'detail'->>'comparisonValue' AS comparison_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->'conditions') c WHERE c->>'conditionType'='EVENT_VALUE_COMPARE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject, r.event_source->'detail'->>'attributeKey' AS attribute_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'thresholdValue' AS threshold_value, r.event_source->'detail'->>'direction' AS direction FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('HEALTH_THRESHOLD_CROSSED')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, b->>'bindingKey' AS binding_key, b->'detail'->>'stateKey' AS state_key, b->'detail'->>'valueKind' AS value_kind, b->'detail'->>'optionKey' AS option_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a->'runtimeInputBindings') b WHERE b->>'sourceType'='INTERNAL_STATE'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, c->>'conditionKey' AS condition_key, c->'detail'->>'stateKey' AS state_key, c->'detail'->>'valueKind' AS value_kind, c->'detail'->>'optionKey' AS option_key, (c->'detail'->>'expectedBoolean')::boolean AS expected_boolean, c->'detail'->>'comparator' AS comparator, c->'detail'->>'comparisonValue' AS comparison_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->'conditions') c WHERE c->>'conditionType'='INTERNAL_STATE_CHECK'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'stateKey' AS state_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'changeKind' AS change_kind FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('INTERNAL_STATE_CHANGED')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'effectKey' AS effect_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'moment' AS lifecycle_moment FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('LIFECYCLE_MOMENT')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'sourceSkillKey' AS source_skill_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('HIT_LINK_APPLIED','ATTACK_LINK_APPLIED')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.limits->'perTargetCooldown'->>'durationValue' AS duration_value, r.limits->'perTargetCooldown'->>'targetContext' AS target_context FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.limits->'perTargetCooldown' IS NOT NULL AND r.limits->'perTargetCooldown' <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, b->>'bindingKey' AS binding_key, b->'detail'->>'sourceActionKey' AS source_action_key, (SELECT sa->'detail'->>'effectKey' FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) sa WHERE sa->>'actionKey'=b->'detail'->>'sourceActionKey') AS source_effect_key, b->'detail'->>'sourceResultKey' AS source_result_key, b->'detail'->>'outputKind' AS output_kind FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a->'runtimeInputBindings') b WHERE b->>'sourceType'='PRIOR_ACTION_RESULT'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, a->'detail'->>'processKey' AS process_key, a->'detail'->>'failureReason' AS failure_reason FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a WHERE a->>'actionType' IN ('START_PROCESS','FAIL_PROCESS')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'processKey' AS process_key, r.event_source->'detail'->'moment'->>'momentType' AS moment_type, r.event_source->'detail'->'moment'->>'stepKey' AS step_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('PROCESS_MOMENT','PROCESS_CANCEL_REQUESTED')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.limits->'maxTriggersPerProcess'->>'processKey' AS process_key, r.limits->'maxTriggersPerProcess'->>'limitValue' AS limit_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.limits->'maxTriggersPerProcess' IS NOT NULL AND r.limits->'maxTriggersPerProcess' <> 'null'::jsonb

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'effectKey' AS effect_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'resultKey' AS result_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('RESULT_AVAILABLE')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, j->>'resultKey' AS result_key, a->'detail'->>'effectKey' AS effect_key, (j->>'fixedMultiplier')::numeric AS fixed_multiplier, (j->>'fixedMinValue')::numeric AS fixed_min_value, (j->>'fixedMaxValue')::numeric AS fixed_max_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a->'resultModifiers') j

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, a->>'actionKey' AS action_key, b->>'bindingKey' AS binding_key, b->>'parameterKey' AS parameter_key, b->>'sourceType' AS source_type FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.actions) a CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a->'runtimeInputBindings') b

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'sourceSkillKey' AS source_skill_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'useKind' AS use_kind FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('SKILL_USED','SKILL_HIT')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'shieldEffectKey' AS shield_effect_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('SPELL_SHIELD_BLOCKED')

SELECT r.game_id, r.skill_key, r.rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, c->>'conditionKey' AS condition_key, c->'detail'->>'effectKey' AS effect_key FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->'conditions') c WHERE c->>'conditionType' = 'LIFECYCLE_CHECK'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, g->>'groupKey' AS group_key, c->>'conditionKey' AS condition_key, c->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject, c->'detail'->>'statusKey' AS status_key, c->'detail'->>'checkKind' AS check_kind, c->'detail'->>'sourceEffectKey' AS source_effect_key, c->'detail'->>'sourceResultKey' AS source_result_key, c->'detail'->>'comparator' AS comparator, c->'detail'->>'comparisonValue' AS comparison_value FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.condition_groups) g CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g->'conditions') c WHERE c->>'conditionType'='STATUS_CHECK'

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject, r.event_source->'detail'->>'statusKey' AS status_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'change' AS change_kind FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('STATUS_CHANGED')

SELECT r.game_id AS game_id, r.skill_key AS skill_key, r.rule_key AS rule_key, r.event_source->'detail'->>'subject' AS subject FROM public.skill_trigger_rules r WHERE r.event_type IN ('ENTITY_DIED','ENTITY_UNTARGETABLE')
